P1.hypothesis: P1 (Original): Delta Re-ID (Biometric Ensemble & Rank-1) > 0 with 95% CI lower bound > 0
P1.rationale: Ebright Biometric Ensemble Delta = +0.0056 (cluster 95% CI [-0.0149, 0.0317], image 95% CI [-0.0124, 0.0244], Wilcoxon p=0.3754); Holdout Delta = -0.0162 (cluster CI [-0.092, 0.0661]); Combined Delta = -0.0026 (cluster CI [-0.039, 0.033]). Lower bound <= 0 across splits.

P2.rationale: Ebright Spatial Pass = 97.5% (39/40, >=90% MET) and Combined = 93.75% (60/64, >=90%), but Holdout Spatial Pass = 87.5% (21/24, <90% NOT MET due to missing 3rd character on all 3 Scene 4 renders).

P3.rationale: Ebright Wardrobe Pass = 80.0% (32/40, >=60% MET) and Combined = 64.06% (41/64, >=60%), but Holdout Wardrobe Pass = 37.5% (9/24, <60% NOT MET vs v1 41.7%).

P4.hypothesis: P4 (Original): Engineering (Peak VRAM <= 7.4 GB, 0 OOMs, 0 extra YOLO persons)
P4.rationale: Whole-system Peak VRAM = 7984 MiB (7.797 GiB > 7400 MB / 7577.6 MiB target; 52s > 7400 MiB; 29s > 7577.6 MiB), while process-attributable delta (max - 973 MiB idle) = 7011 MiB (6.847 GiB), 0 OOMs, and extra_person_detector.py (conf=0.40) flagged 1/42 extra YOLO persons (v2 Ebright scene_5_seed_1202.png; Verifier YOLO also flagged scene_2_seed_1303.png).

hypothesis_scorecard.overall_scorecard_verdict: ORIGINAL PRE-REGISTRATION: 0/4 STRICT ALL-SPLIT RULES MET (P1 NOT MET; P2/P3 MET on Ebright & Combined only, NOT MET on Holdout; P4 NOT MET)
